mapper.select: SELECT at.id AS transaction_id, at.desc3 AS merchant_name, CONCAT_WS(' ', at.desc2, at.desc3) AS description, at.out_amount AS amount, STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(at.tran_date, at.tran_time), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s' ) AS transaction_date FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION at INNER JOIN ACCOUNT a ON at.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT( STR_TO_DATE(at.tran_date, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y-%m' ) = #{yearMonth} AND at.out_amount IS NOT NULL AND at.out_amount > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TXN_ANALYSIS ( account_transaction_id, is_consumption, category, expense_type, classified_at ) VALUES ( #{accountTransactionId}, #{isConsumption}, #{category}, #{expenseType}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_consumption = VALUES(is_consumption), category = VALUES(category), expense_type = VALUES(expense_type), classified_at = NOW()
